name: Chronic Recurrent Multifocal Osteomyelitis

criteria.description: Presence of multifocal bone lesions on imaging
Histopathological evidence of sterile bone inflammation without bacterial infection
Recurrent episodes of localized bone pain and swelling
Negative microbiological cultures from bone biopsy
Lack of systemic infection or immunodeficiency markers

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of multifocal sterile bone inflammation with recurrent symptoms and exclusion of infectious causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and radiological, supported by biopsy and exclusion of infection and malignancy

pathognomonic.symptomName: Radiologic evidence of lytic and sclerotic bone lesions

common.symptomName: Limited range of motion near affected joints

occasional.symptomName: Soft tissue swelling adjacent to bone lesions
Skin manifestations such as pustulosis or psoriasis

laboratory: Elevated ESR and CRP during active disease
Negative blood and bone biopsy cultures
imaging: MRI showing multifocal bone marrow edema
X-rays with lytic and sclerotic lesions
Bone scintigraphy demonstrating multiple active sites
genetic: Association with mutations in LPIN2, IL1RN, and other autoinflammatory genes in some cases
other: Histopathology showing sterile chronic inflammation with neutrophilic and lymphocytic infiltrates

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of malignant cells on biopsy
Unifocal lesion with aggressive bone destruction
Systemic symptoms like weight loss and night sweats
Primary joint involvement rather than bone lesions
Presence of arthritis and systemic features

references: Jansson AF et al. Diagnostic criteria for chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis (CRMO). J Pediatr. 2007.
Ferguson PJ. Chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis. Curr Opin Rheumatol. 2007.
Wipff J et al. Chronic recurrent multifocal osteomyelitis. Best Pract Res Clin Rheumatol. 2015.
